# Feature glossary

> Generated by `scripts/gen_feature_glossary.py` from `src/approach-retreat.js` (ResultFeatureTracker), `attentional-foraging/scripts/m4_nb21_hybrid_rerun.py` (M4_FEATURES, JS↔Python parity-verified at 1e-6), and `analysis/attcur-validation/run_analysis.py` (WILD analogs). Do not hand-edit; rerun the script.

All LAB features are transformations of the cursor-to-AOI distance d(t) = |cursor page-Y − AOI center page-Y| (vertical distance; in a single-column SERP the horizontal component adds noise without signal), aggregated over the whole click-buffered trial against each result's bounding-box center. Directed velocity v(t) = −Δd/Δt is positive when approaching. Model sets: M1 = rank position only; M2 = position + total_dwell_ms; M3 = M2 + the seven approach features; M4 = the seven buffer-robust approach features alone (the nine computed features minus `final_dist` and `retreat_dist`, which the §5.2 click-buffer leakage screen excludes). WILD (ACD) analogs re-derive the vector for cursor+click-only telemetry: eight features after the WILD leakage screen drops `retreat_dist` (`final_dist` has no WILD referent — it requires fixation-timed sampling).

| Feature | Type / units | Definition | Formula sketch | Model sets |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Per-AOI approach features (LAB, AdSERP)** | | | | |
| `min_dist` | px | Minimum cursor-to-AOI-center distance over the whole trial (closest approach). | min_t d(t) | M3, M4 |
| `mean_dist` | px | Mean cursor-to-AOI-center distance over all samples. | (1/n) Sum_t d(t) | M3, M4 |
| `final_dist` | px | Distance at the last cursor sample. Structurally pinned by gaze-cursor convergence at click time. | d(t_end) | excluded from M4 (leakage screen, §5.2) |
| `retreat_dist` | px | Post-closest-approach drift: final distance minus minimum distance. Zero by construction when click lock-on holds. | final_dist − min_dist | excluded from M4 (leakage screen, §5.2) |
| `dwell_in_proximity_ms` | ms | Cumulative time the cursor spends within the 100 px proximity zone of the AOI center; inter-sample gaps ≥ 2000 ms (tab-switch / away-from-keyboard) are not accumulated. | Sum Δt where d(t) < 100 px, Δt < 2 s | M3, M4 |
| `mean_approach_velocity` | px/s | Mean directed approach rate; positive = closing on the AOI (negative on average by design: retreat intervals dominate a trial). | mean_t v(t), v(t) = −Δd/Δt | M3, M4 |
| `max_approach_velocity` | px/s | Peak single-interval directed approach rate. | max_t v(t) | M3, M4 |
| `direction_changes` | count | Sign flips in the directed-velocity sequence (approach ↔ retreat), counting transitions through zero. | #{sign(v_t) ≠ sign(v_{t−1})} | M3, M4 |
| `frac_decreasing` | 0–1 | Fraction of sample transitions on which distance decreased (cursor moving toward the AOI). | #{Δd < 0} / (n−1) | M3, M4 |
| `sample_count` | count | Number of cursor samples aggregated for this AOI. Diagnostic field emitted by the JS tracker; not a model input. | n | — (diagnostic) |
| **Dwell aggregate baseline (LAB, AdSERP)** | | | | |
| `total_dwell_ms` | ms | Per-result total dwell, the M2/M3 baseline. LAB referent: sum of gaze-fixation durations attributed to the result's AOI (attentional-foraging/scripts/compute_cursor_approach_features.py). The JS library separately emits a cursor analog under the same name — getSignals().total_dwell_ms, the sum of per-episode in-AOI cursor dwell — same name, different sensor; do not conflate. | LAB: Sum fixation durations on AOI; JS: Sum episode dwell_ms | M2, M3 (and §5.3's eight-feature M3-no-position vector); excluded from M4 |
| **WILD analog features (ACD, attcur-validation)** | | | | |
| `dwell_in_target_ms` | ms | WILD analog of the dwell baseline: cumulative cursor time inside the target-ad bounding box (Δt counted when both interval endpoints are in-target). | Sum Δt where in_target(t) ∧ in_target(t+1) | WILD M2/M3-analogs; excluded from M4-analog (§5.1) |
| `n_target_entries` | count | Cursor entries into the target bounding box (out→in transitions; +1 if the session starts in-target). | #{in_target: 0→1} | WILD M3/M4-analogs (§5.1) |
| `n_events` | count | Total telemetry events in the session; stands in (with session_ms) for the velocity terms ACD's low-rate log cannot support. | count(events) | WILD M3/M4-analogs (§5.1) |
| `session_ms` | ms | Session duration: last minus first event timestamp. | t_last − t_first | WILD M3/M4-analogs (§5.1) |
